snippet.title: Storebound | Official 1.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Storebound Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3417410/Storebound/ 
Join on Discord: https://discord.gg/QmHJcFrRmq

Storebound a 1-3 co-op puzzle horror game. Lost in an accursed megastore, work together to find the exit before its lurking horrors trap you forever.

Follow on TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@storebound 
Follow on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/storebound_game/
